title: CSRF: tokens, the SameSite attribute and origin checks

videos.script: Lucia is signed in to the portal in one tab. In another tab she reads some other site. {{tabs}} That site can contain a form that posts to the portal. And her browser, helpful as ever, attaches the portal's cookie to it. {{cookie}} The portal sees a valid session asking to change her e-mail address. It has no way to tell she never pressed the button. {{change}} That is cross-site request forgery. The request is real. The intention is not hers. {{intention}} Three defences: a token only the portal's own pages know, a cookie the browser keeps to its own site, and a look at where the request came from. {{three}} Today all three go into the portal, each with a test. {{today}}
